verdict.rationale: The evidence documents REST endpoints, a Python SDK and an llms.txt docs index, but nothing shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable API spec. The probe found 404s at every candidate OpenAPI and Swagger path. llms.txt is an LLM-oriented documentation index, not an API spec, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
